svg.aria-label: Weights against decode rate on a log scale, coloured and shaped by class. The MoE band sits above the dense band at every size: `lfm25-24b-a2b-think` decodes at 111 tok/s on 12.65 GiB while `mistral-24b-q4` manages 14.9 on 13.35
